description: This file defines the BudgetProvider class, which manages a list of budget items including CRUD operations. It interacts with a BudgetService for data retrieval and updates, and uses ChangeNotifier for state management in a Flutter app.

classes.name: BudgetProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the list of budgets, including loading, adding, updating, and removing budget items.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of budgets for the selected month from the BudgetService.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Sets the current month for the budgets and triggers a reload.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new budget by calling the create method on BudgetService and updates the local list.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing budget by ID and refreshes the local list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a budget by ID from the backend and updates the local list.
